status: development only; October-November already inspected; no reserved December outcomes
target: Positive product units on order dates with normalized statuses completed, shipped or returned; include returned positive units as gross outgoing, do not subtract restockable returns without evidence. Remove exact duplicates, reject conflicting transaction IDs, quarantine negative quantities. Include zero quantity records without effect.
missing_dates: Do not impute missing input quantities. Aggregate recorded units to calendar windows, conditional on supplied transaction extract representing recorded orders; no claim that absence proves zero underlying demand. Global dates are continuous. Store-day absences may be closure, no sales or missing reporting. Check exposure sensitivity using store transaction-active dates and independently report performance on horizons with all store dates observed. Do not represent transaction inventory levels as historical stock.
population: Current supplied stock/policy keys, checked for 1:1 agreement and historical support at every origin; 336 pairs. Historical assortment not supplied: fixed current population is conditional and not proof of historical availability.
training: All eligible records available by each origin. Previous-month baseline uses last completed calendar month. Shrinkage uses trailing 84 calendar days. Poisson uses complete Monday-Sunday weeks from 2022-01-03 through origin, with fixed alpha 0.01, product/store categorical effects, annual sine/cosine and linear year trend. No future sales, prices, status-derived features or inventory features.
deployment_coverage: Supplier lead time 1-7 plus review 7 = 8-14 days. Secondary variable horizon uses November 30 policy as a forecast-horizon diagnostic, not historical purchasing policy. Primary next-week selection may differ from full-coverage performance; disclose if so.
baseline: Previous completed calendar month units / calendar days, separately by product and store. Analytical interpretation of supplied last-month description; exact incumbent not evaluable.

candidates.name: previous_month
candidates.rationale: Fair simple comparison connected to last-month context, no invented incumbent rules.

candidates.name: shrinkage84
candidates.rationale: Sparse pair data need variance reduction; trailing 84-day pair rate shrunk toward product total times store share, with fixed 28 pseudo-days.

candidates.name: poisson_seasonal
candidates.rationale: Conventional low-complexity pooled count regression can share evidence and use repeated annual seasonality; 44 sparse features, bounded fit.

primary_metric.name: MAE7
primary_metric.definition: Mean absolute error of 7-calendar-day total recorded gross units across all origins and product/store keys, equal pair-origin weighting
primary_metric.unit: product units per product at store per week
primary_metric.business_reason: Unit errors are directly interpretable for quantity planning without inventing a stockout cost or excess-stock preference.

selection_rule: Select minimum primary MAE; absolute ties within 1e-9 favor baseline, then shrinkage84, then Poisson. No invented meaningful-improvement threshold. Report supporting metrics and selection sensitivity without changing this rule.
secondary_diagnostics: WAPE as aggregate absolute error / observed units
fixed-origin block bootstrap of candidate-baseline difference (development uncertainty only)
search_control: One fixed prospective comparison; retain all scores. Any extension requires a versioned prospective plan and is exploratory. No tuning to a win.
success_gate: Not met or closable: no externally predeclared meaningful threshold or genuinely untouched independent evaluation; December withheld. Forecast errors do not measure availability or savings.
